He was referred to as the Russian pupil for his elegant style.

entities.summary: Svetolik Ranković was a Serbian writer prominent in the period of Realism. As a realist, he was the first Serbian author to take a significant step towards the emancipation of prose from the laws of event-centered narration. He was referred to as the Russian pupil for his elegant style.
